status: Arithmetic-only interim review; scientific acceptance pending
scope: One conditional donor support comparison, not measured patient response or donation capacity
formula: Independently compute offered=gift/cashLikeCost*patients*funding; new=offered*completion*(1-purchasers-otherFree); physical and mental assigned disjoint observed count shares; health=(physical*physicalUtility*.75+mental*mentalUtility*1-new*treatmentHarm-offered*offerHarm)/(1+discount)^.5. No mortality or lifetime earnings bonus.
